formula: m = q · B² · r² / (2·U)   (accélération puis déviation)
sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with 3 zones — ionisation source, accélérateur
(electric field U), déviateur (magnetic field B) — and a detector
arc. Ions of mass m, charge q enter, accelerated to v = √(2qU/m),
curved by B into circle R = mv/(qB); m ↔ R mapping shown live.
Student sets U, B, m. Experiment: 3 seeded target m; student tunes
U and B to land ion on the correct detector cell (isotope
separation). Evaluate: full trajectory hidden; only source and
detector cells shown; student picks (U, B) from m.
